mapper.sql: CAST(r.id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(r.reporter_account_id AS CHAR) AS reporterAccountId,COALESCE(m.username,'') AS reporterName, r.target_type AS targetType,CAST(r.target_id AS CHAR) AS targetId,CAST(r.thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,r.reason,r.detail,r.status, CAST(r.handler_account_id AS CHAR) AS handlerAccountId,r.handler_name AS handlerName,r.handle_result AS handleResult, DATE_FORMAT(r.handled_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS handledAt,DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, t.title AS threadTitle,CASE WHEN r.target_type='thread' THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(rt.excerpt,''),rt.title) WHEN r.target_type='comment' THEN c.content ELSE '' END AS targetContent

LEFT JOIN forum_member m ON m.account_id=r.reporter_account_id LEFT JOIN forum_thread t ON t.id=r.thread_id LEFT JOIN forum_thread rt ON rt.id=r.target_id AND r.target_type='thread' LEFT JOIN forum_comment c ON c.id=r.target_id AND r.target_type='comment'
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM forum_report r
WHERE r.id=#{id}

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(reporter_account_id AS CHAR) AS reporterAccountId,target_type AS targetType,CAST(target_id AS CHAR) AS targetId, CAST(thread_id AS CHAR) AS threadId,status FROM forum_report WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_report SET status=#{status},handler_account_id=#{handlerAccountId},handler_name=#{handlerName}, handle_result=#{handleResult},handled_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
